snippet.title: Ministry of Order - Official Steam Page Trailer | Indie puzzle & simulation game
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572310/Ministry_of_Order/?utm_source=youtube&utm_term=trailer1

You’ve been assigned to the Maternity Ward in a totalitarian 1920s state. Reunite newborns with their rightful parents using a simplified genetics puzzle - no mistakes allowed. Obey the regime, join a secret conspiracy, or forge your own path.

Twitter: https://x.com/VoltekPlay
Itch: https://voltekplay.itch.io/

#trailer #indiegame #puzzlegame
